text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz arrives in New York to attend a U.N. meeting.
- A French industrial and economic team arrives in Baghdad.
- President Saddam Hussein receives letter from Iranian President.
- Indonesian firms to hold medical exhibition in Baghdad.
- National Assembly Speaker Saadoun Hammadi meets with Jordanian MPs.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- National Assembly condemns the U.S. House of Representatives reaffirming a previous decision to move U.S. embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem.
- Editorial accusing chief U.N. inspector Rolf Ekeus of implementing a U.S. policy.
- Iraq starts manufacturing oil tools for Qurana and Ahdab oilfields which Baghdad had contracted with Russia and China respectively to develop.
- An international mission in Iraq to assess the food situation in Iraq.
